# Repeat

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Loops](Language-Features-Loops)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Repeat
statements
Until condition
Repeat
statements
Forever
```

## Description

Runs the statements, then ends with [Until](Until) when its condition is true, or with [Forever](Forever) never on its own. Because the condition is tested last, the statements run at least once.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
n = 10
Repeat
	Print n
	n = n + 1
Until n > 3
```

```text
10
```

## Related Commands

[Forever](Forever), [Next](Next), [Step](Step), [To](To)
